notes.title: Demo bug fixes and Quality of Life update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Here is a little update for the demo that addresses a few bugs and thanks to your suggestion some quality-of-life updates!


"All in One" challange
Can you beat the Speedrun, Kill All and No Damage challenge in one run?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507249/e250abd00dea85bc5ef949a91547439de648a8cb.png

Rest of fixes and changes

 Added Remappable keys
 Quick restart level button (default F5)
 Able to use an unconfined aim cursor
 Added mouse sensitivity option
 Invisible code to help speedrunners set up an autosplitter
 Added prompt to help communicate that you can skip through the death screen sequence
 Two very minor bugs fixed
